correctness.rationale: Length-one overlap prohibits any intersection between first-letter and last-letter alphabets, so all solutions lie in fourteen finite partition classes. In each, eligible self-border-free words are exactly 15|A||B| vertices. Compatibility edges encode Hamming distance at least 2 plus both overlap directions, making codes exactly graph cliques. Exhaustive Bron--Kerbosch maximal clique enumeration in verify_primary.py proves maximum 9 or 12 by partition, 24 distinct maximizers and two S4 orbits of 12; a second independently implemented color-bounded exact clique counter in verify_secondary.py finds 24 twelve-cliques and no thirteen-cliques in the same exhaustive universe. Both scripts were executed and asserted the outputs. The proof is finite, no asymptotic or external independent certification.

originality.rationale: The old unconstrained q=n=4 optimum 27 (Blackburn) does not imply the joint Hamming/overlap bound. The closest exactly equivalent parameter is A_MU(4,4,2,1) defined by Levy--Yaakobi; their theorem gives only <=16, not the exact value 12 nor the complete set of 24 maximizers and two alphabet-relabeling classes. Chee et al. supply different unconstrained constructions, while newer (1,k) overlap papers give general bounds for other parameter families. Statement-level published-finding corpus and primary literature searches revealed no exact earlier 12/24 theorem. The publisher-fulltext and unindexed-enumeration risks are expressly retained.
residual_risks: The related 2025 article DOI:10.1016/j.disc.2024.114236 was only accessible via abstract and substantial section excerpts, not its full publisher PDF. An unexamined appendix might contain a small-parameter table.
Unindexed or unpublished computational enumerations could precede this exact finite result; a semantic-index miss cannot prove global novelty.

value.rationale: The invariant naturally combines zero ambiguity at all frame shifts with detection of any one-symbol substitution between address codewords. The exact first square quaternary n=q=4 benchmark closes the general 16-versus-construction gap to 12, and all 24 solutions split into two genuinely distinct symbol-permutation families. Complete equality classification adds structural value beyond simply testing examples; this is not claimed as a general theorem, a biological barcode assay, or single-error correction.
